description: `Final Review` replaces the shared preset's `dependencies` label, in `labels` and in `vulnerabilityAlerts.labels`: label-triggered-review.yml fires on it, so dependency PRs get an Argos visual review. Keep it in both places, otherwise one kind of Renovate PR silently skips that review.

packageRules.description: katex 0.19 conflicts with the peer range of marked-katex-extension (katex >=0.16 <0.19, pulled in by ngx-markdown) and breaks `npm ci`. Remove this rule once marked-katex-extension supports katex 0.19.
